## 4. Scope & Honesty Disclosure

This benchmark evaluates pipeline accuracy across 10 representative Nigerian electoral guideline pairs and 30 civic-education materials. In accordance with PRD Section 9, this benchmark validates the MVP release gates and does not establish nationwide legal completeness or autonomous verification authority.
